boundary_condition: set to zero by the standard no-extra-homogeneous-mode / no-incoming-scalar PPN boundary condition
consequence: Through O(v^3), the full fixed-action shift/vector equations coincide with the corresponding sigma1=sigma2=0 pure-U1 family-I equations for a1=1,a2=0,kappa=1.

first_variation.P_sector: P=P_X=0 through O3, so no lapse/shift/spatial-metric/scalar source from P(X) at this order
first_variation.mixed_sector: the first variation of C(X) g^{ij}D_iTheta D_jTheta vanishes when D_iTheta=0; no O3 vector/shift source
first_variation.scalar_equation: Sigma=q t remains unsourced through O3 on the no-extra-homogeneous-mode PPN branch because both P_X and D_iTheta vanish at the background to this order

next_gate: preferred-frame alpha1/alpha2 inheritance with regular algebraic cancellation before gamma1=-1 and lambda_HL=1 limits
non_claims: does not prove absence of freely specified RTK scalar waves; the PPN branch excludes an independent incoming/homogeneous scalar excitation
does not cover strong-field rotation, compact objects, DBI-boundary configurations or X_U->0
does not yet set alpha1 or alpha2 until the separate preferred-frame inheritance gate checks the U1 formulas and limiting cancellations
does not establish radiative stability, UV completion, strong-coupling scale or EFT cutoff

o2_bridge.statement: The O(2) scalar constraints are unchanged by O(3) shift/time-derivative terms; the certified regular solution is n2=0.

ppn_ordering.K_ij: O(3), hence quadratic K terms begin at O(6)
ppn_ordering.bare_lapse: N=1+n2+O(4); the O(2) Hamiltonian/A scalar subsystem is unchanged by O(3) shift terms and requires n2=0 under the same regular asymptotic boundary condition
ppn_ordering.one_time_derivative: raises PN order by one relative to one spatial derivative
